recipe.title: Shakshuka
recipe.description: Eggs gently poached in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.instruction: Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer until slightly thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan.

recipe.title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
recipe.description: A golden, juicy whole chicken with lemon, garlic, and rosemary.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 425°F and pat the chicken dry.
Rub the chicken with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Stuff with halved lemons and garlic.
Roast until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes before carving.

recipe.title: Basil Pasta with Toasted Sunflower Seeds
recipe.description: A bright, nut-free take on pesto pasta.

steps.instruction: Boil the rigatoni until al dente, saving a cup of pasta water.
Blend the basil, sunflower seeds, garlic, parmesan, olive oil, and lemon juice until smooth.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

recipe.notes: Sunflower seeds stand in for pine nuts to keep it tree-nut free.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Beat the butter and sugars until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop onto lined trays and bake until the edges are golden.

recipe.title: Grandma's French Onion Soup

steps.instruction: Melt the butter and cook the onions low and slow until deep brown.
Add the wine and scrape the pan, then add the broth and thyme and simmer.
Top bowls with bread and cheese and broil until bubbly.

recipe.notes: Replaced beef broth with vegetable broth to keep the recipe kosher with the butter and Gruyère.
recipe.original_text:
Grandma's French Onion Soup
4 tbsp butter
3 lbs yellow onions, sliced thin
6 cups beef broth
1 cup dry white wine
2 sprigs thyme
Salt and pepper
Baguette slices + 2 cups grated gruyere for the top
Melt the butter, cook onions low and slow ~45 min till deep brown. Add wine, scrape pan, add broth + thyme, simmer 30 min.
Top bowls w/ bread and cheese and broil till bubbly.
